subject: Dedicated capacity pricing follow-up: GPU sizing, throughput, and $/1M token target
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Platform Ops <platform-ops@acme.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-25T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + follow-ups (Dedicated capacity sizing & $/1M token target)

Hi Sam / Platform team —

Thanks again for the call earlier — good discussion. Quick recap and a few follow-ups so we can get a scoped Dedicated proposal over to procurement:

Summary from call:
- Deployment mode: Dedicated reserved capacity behind your VPC (required for data isolation).
- Model: open Llama variant (7B → 13B family, final model TBD).
- Expected monthly token volume: ~2B tokens/month (range you mentioned 1.5B–2.5B).
- Peak concurrency: ~20 concurrent inference streams.
- Latency SLO: 90–120ms p95 for typical chat requests (short context, ~40–80 tokens/res).
- Throughput goal: sustained throughput to support 50 tokens/sec per request at 20 concurrent streams → ~1k tokens/sec sustained peak; bursts higher.
- Target unit economics: you called out a target of ~$250–$350 per 1M tokens (ideally toward $250).

Open questions for you (so our pricing/size recs match):
1) Can you confirm the 1.5B–2.5B/month range as firm for 6–12 month forecasting?
2) Any hard constraints on preferred GPU type (H100 vs A100) or cloud (GCP vs AWS vs Azure)?
3) Is sub-120ms p95 a hard requirement for all requests or just for a subset of high-priority traffic?
4) Will you want cross-region failover or single-region Dedicated pool?

Attached: estimated_pricing_breakdown.xlsx (high-level cost model + assumptions).

Next steps suggested from our side:
- Sam confirms the items above by EOD Monday.
- Redwood SE (Marcus) will propose 2 capacity options (cost-focused and latency-focused) with estimated $/1M tokens.
- Align on preferred option and schedule a short procurement sync to review SOW/ordering timeline.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: estimated_pricing_breakdown.xlsx (12KB, xlsx)

From: Sam Rivera <sam.rivera@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Platform Ops <platform-ops@acme.com>
Date: 2027-06-26T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + follow-ups (Dedicated capacity sizing & $/1M token target)

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the numbers and adding a couple clarifications:

- Monthly tokens: confirmed 1.5B–2.5B for Q3 forecast (we'll re-evaluate monthly). If we ramp in Q4 we could hit the top of the range.
- Latency: the <120ms p95 is important for our primary chat flow (customer-facing); we can accept higher latency for background batch scoring. So this applies to ~80% of traffic.
- GPUs/cloud: no hard vendor contract yet; prefer H100 if pricing is reasonable because of throughput for the model family.
- Failover: single-region (us-west) for initial launch; cross-region failover later is OK but not required for purchase.
- Procurement: to move forward we need a 60–90 day lead time on SOW/license and a one-year reserved term if pricing meets our target.

Budget note: Procurement wants to see an estimate at or below $300/1M tokens to consider moving to a 1-year commit. If you can show a path to $250/1M at scale (2–3M tokens/day sustained) that will get us to an exec approval discussion.

Happy to jump on a short follow-up demo/technical call if Marcus wants to validate throughput numbers.

—Sam
Sam Rivera
Director, Platform Engineering — Acme Corp
sam.rivera@acme.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Rivera <sam.rivera@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-27T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated sizing options / initial economics (H100 vs A100)

Sam / Marissa —

Thanks for the context. Based on the target latency (p95 <120ms for primary chat), concurrency (~20), and the monthly token range (1.5B–2.5B), here are two pragmatic Dedicated configurations we recommend along with rough unit economics (ballpark; final depends on model perf and batching):

Option A — Latency-focused (recommended for strict p95 SLA)
- Hardware: 4x H100 GPUs in reserved pool (single-region us-west)
- Throughput: supports ~20 concurrent streams @ ~50 tokens/sec each with p95 ~80–110ms (depends on prompt length and model).
- Estimated cost: ~ $290–$340 per 1M tokens (with our default batching + KV cache assumptions).
- Notes: This gives headroom for short bursts and keeps p95 within target for most chat flows. Good middle ground for your stated target (~$250–$350).

Option B — Cost-focused (higher throughput per $ at expense of some p95 tail)
- Hardware: 8x A100 GPUs (higher aggregate throughput for cheaper GPU-hours)
- Throughput: higher aggregate token throughput but p95 may increase for tail latency (120–180ms for some requests).
- Estimated cost: ~ $200–$260 per 1M tokens with aggressive batching and prefix caching; this hits your aspirational $250 target at the high end of the token range but may not meet p95 for all high-priority traffic.

Other notes and levers:
- Batching & KV cache: With persistent KV cache for session state (chat applications), effective token costs can drop ~15–25% depending on session reuse. We'll model with conservative 10% cache benefit for the first proposal.
- Autoscaling/burst: We can add short burst capacity (pay-as-you-go) to handle spikes rather than overprovisioning reserved GPUs — useful for cost control.
- Commitment term: 12-month reserved term will materially reduce unit price; we can show both 12-month committed and month-to-month blended rates.

I'll attach a concise config comparison (dedicated_config_options.pdf) with per-hour GPU cost assumptions and a worked example for 2B tokens/month. If helpful I can run a quick perf test (30–60m) against your chosen model/size to tighten latency numbers — we just need a test model snapshot and a small set of representative prompts.

Next step proposal:
- Marissa: share the attached config comparison and the two options with procurement.
- Sam: confirm whether you prefer Option A (latency) or Option B (cost) or want a hybrid (e.g., H100x4 + small A100 burst pool).
- If you pick A, we can size a 12-month commit quote that gets closer to $250/1M tokens.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Attachment: dedicated_config_options.pdf (85KB, pdf)
